items.name: ASUS ROG STRIX Z390-I GAMING

items.supply_risk: The board is discontinued in many retail channels; obtain the exact model and inspect the rear M.2_2 hardware before final assembly.
items.selection_reason: Matches the current user-specified motherboard in product/requirements.json.

required_user_evidence: Advisory procurement reminder: choose the socket-compatible retail variant for the final motherboard/CPU.
items.selection_reason: Named cooler in the confirmed PRD.

items.name: Colorful GeForce RTX 3060 NB DUO 12G V3 L-V
items.description: User-measured dual-slot graphics card body is 241 x 132.5 x 41 mm; the rear L-ear extends 8.8 mm for a 249.8 mm total CAD length envelope. The card is inverted with PCIe fingers upward.
items.mpn: GeForce RTX 3060 NB DUO 12G V3 L-V
required_user_evidence: Advisory procurement reminder: verify the purchased card matches the measured V3 L-V body and rear bracket geometry.
items.supply_risk: The auxiliary-power connector proxy was removed from CAD because it did not match the physical card; cable routing and connector clearance remain user-owned.
items.selection_reason: Matches the current user-specified GPU and physical measurements while retaining the active decision that the card is dual-slot and the user will handle power cabling.

items.name: Standard SFX power supply

required_user_evidence: Advisory procurement reminder: record the final SFX manufacturer/model, AC-inlet orientation and modular-connector layout before purchase.
items.supply_risk: Exact commercial model and cable exits remain user-selected; it must use the standard SFX body and fit the modeled rear insertion and service interfaces.
items.selection_reason: Matches the current standard-SFX requirement while preserving the active user decision that exact PSU selection is user-owned.

items.name: Cooler Master PCIe 4.0 x16 riser cable 200 mm
items.description: Exact 200 mm PCIe 4.0 x16 riser cable connecting the standard Mini-ITX x16 slot to the rear dual-slot GPU position; no printed riser clamp or receiver support is used.
items.supply_risk: Supplier lookup did not establish transaction stock; exact identity and 200 mm interface are fixed for design.
items.selection_reason: Agent-selected exact 200 mm Gen4 riser under active receipt e8c2b6ee-e988-4dda-8a06-3ec68e20e029; current CAD relies only on standard motherboard and GPU interfaces.

cad_relevance.retention: standard motherboard x16 connector and rear dual-slot GPU bracket; no printed clamp

items.name: 10 x 5 x 2 mm plain rectangular magnets
items.description: Eight unperforated rectangular magnets bonded into compact screwless pockets: four on the front end panel and four on the rear end panel.
required_user_evidence: Advisory procurement reminder: verify actual 10 x 5 x 2 mm dimensions, polarity and coating before ordering.
items.supply_risk: Commercial magnet dimensional tolerance and coating thickness vary; dry-fit one magnet in the 10.5 x 5.5 x 2.0 mm CAD pocket before bonding the full set.
items.selection_reason: The user explicitly corrected the retained design to eight 10 x 5 x 2 mm adhesive magnets with no magnet-retention screws; the surrounding front and rear carriers are simplified only.

items.name: 10 x 10 x 1 mm steel strike plates
items.description: Eight plain ferromagnetic plates bonded into the compact inner-face recesses of the removable left and right side panels, four per side panel.
required_user_evidence: Advisory procurement reminder: verify the plates are ferromagnetic and fit the 10.3 x 10.3 x 1.15 mm CAD recesses.
items.supply_risk: Plate flatness, coating and adhesive thickness can reduce magnetic contact; test one assembled front/rear station before bonding all eight plates.
items.selection_reason: The confirmed panel-retention requirement uses matching steel strike features on the two removable side panels; dimensions match the current CAD strike-pocket parameters.

items.name: ISO 4762 M3 x 8 socket-head screw
items.description: Four screws fasten the top cap to the columns, four fasten the rear panel to the rear columns, two fasten the independent lower motherboard mounts through the base, and two fasten the independent upper motherboard mounts through the top cap.
items.selection_reason: Revision 67 uses four kit-owned M3x8 top-cap joints: each screw passes through the complete 5 mm two-layer cap and engages 3 mm in its corner column. The same row also covers the screw-fixed rear panel and four independent motherboard-mount-to-plate interfaces; no heat-set insert is modeled.

items.name: ISO 4762 M3 x 4 socket-head screw
items.description: Four short screws fasten the Mini-ITX board to the printed arms; two more are inserted from below, pass upward through the GPU bracket ears, and engage the Revision 66 Z-axis through-threaded rear-panel flange.
items.selection_reason: Revision 50 uses 1.6 mm motherboard thickness plus 2.4 mm light-duty self-forming engagement, resolving exactly to M3x4. Revision 66 places the standard 0.8 mm GPU bracket ear under a 3.2 mm printed flange; printed-screw-joint-v1 termination=through resolves the same M3x4 length for bottom-to-top insertion without a blind floor.

items.name: ISO 4762 M3 x 12 socket-head screw
items.selection_reason: Revision 68 uses four kit-owned M3x12 joints. Each screw enters from the foot underside, passes through the complete 4 mm detachable foot and 3 mm base, then engages its separate printed column; the foot clearance cuts are topologically cleaned so both foot faces remain open.

items.name: Tmall item 655230136762 panel-mount power button
items.description: User-selected front-panel power button from Tmall item 655230136762. The displayed Φ8 mm / Φ10 mm values are treated as mounting-aperture variants; the disclosed design default selects the Φ10 mm version and a 10.2 mm target printed-panel cutout.
required_user_evidence: Advisory fit reminder: order the Φ10 mm variant and measure the received threaded-body diameter before the production front-panel print.
items.supply_risk: The login-gated listing prevented verification of threaded-body length, bezel diameter, rear terminal envelope and cable exit. These remain physical dry-fit checks, but do not block the current CAD because the button body and internal cable path are outside its scope.
items.selection_reason: Preserves the exact Tmall listing supplied by the user. Because the user did not know which displayed Φ8 mm / Φ10 mm option to choose, the disclosed default selects the more substantial Φ10 mm panel-mount variant instead of retaining the obsolete generic 12 mm button.

supply_risks.description: The motherboard and GPU identities are fixed by the current PRD. The exact commercial SFX PSU remains user-selected but is constrained by the standard 125 x 100 x 63.5 mm envelope and rear interface.
